Mail carriers said the new handheld scanners slow them down

Published 2026-10-06 00:00 UTC

Mail carriers at several postal distribution centers said the new handheld scanners introduced this summer have slowed their routes rather than speeding them up. Workers interviewed for this article said their daily route times grew by about 20 minutes after the rollout.

The devices replaced older scanners that carriers had used for nearly a decade. The new models include larger touchscreens, built-in navigation and a camera for proof-of-delivery photos. Management said the features would reduce missed deliveries and give customers better tracking information.

Carriers said the problems are practical. The touchscreens are hard to use with gloves, and the devices often take several seconds to register a scan in areas with poor cellular coverage. The navigation feature sometimes suggests routes that ignore one-way streets or the order in which carriers have delivered for years.

Battery life was another complaint. Several carriers said the devices ran low before the end of long routes in hot weather, forcing them to return early or carry backup batteries. One union representative said members have filed dozens of grievances about overtime caused by delays.

A spokesperson for the postal service said the agency is aware of the feedback and is preparing a software update to improve scanning speed and allow carriers to turn off turn-by-turn directions. The agency said overall delivery performance has remained stable since the new devices arrived.

Workplace technology researchers said the situation is common when tools are designed without input from the people who use them every day. They recommended testing new devices with carriers on real routes before a nationwide rollout, a step workers say was skipped this time.

Carriers in rural areas reported the worst delays, since their routes cover long distances with weak signal. Some said they had returned to writing delivery notes on paper and entering them later, which defeats the purpose of the new tracking features.
